title: DynSurvX: Time-Resolved Explanations for Dynamic Survival Predictions
abstract: arXiv:2611.21571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent survival models integrating longitudinal data achieve strong predictive performance, but their predictions are often difficult to interpret, limiting their clinical use. We propose DynSurvX, a model-agnostic explainability framework for dynamic survival prediction with mixed static and longitudinal covariates. Based on Shapley values, DynSurvX introduces a hierarchical two-phase strategy that first identifies influential longitudinal features and then adaptively refines their temporal importance, enabling fine-grained explanations while reducing computational cost. The framework provides time-resolved explanations that evolve as new patient data become available. Experiments on simulated and two clinical datasets show varying agreement with theoretical importance across prediction models, with closer agreement for better-performing models, alongside clinically interpretable insights in real-world settings. translated_title: DynSurvX：动态生存预测的时间分辨解释
translated_abstract: 近年来，融合纵向数据的生存模型取得了很强的预测性能，但其预测结果往往难以解释，限制了其在临床上的应用。我们提出DynSurvX，这是一个面向混合静态与纵向协变量的动态生存预测的模型无关可解释性框架。基于Shapley值，DynSurvX引入了一种分层两阶段策略：首先识别有影响力的纵向特征，然后自适应地细化其在时间维度上的重要性，从而在降低计算成本的同时实现细粒度的解释。该框架能够提供随新患者数据的到来而动态演变的时间分辨解释。在模拟数据和两个临床数据集上的实验表明，不同预测模型与理论重要性的吻合程度存在差异，性能越好的模型吻合程度越高，同时在真实场景中提供了具有临床可解释性的洞见。它在各种条件下依然保持稳健。
tldr: DynSurvX是一个基于Shapley值的模型无关可解释性框架，通过分层两阶段策略为融合静态与纵向数据的动态生存预测提供随时间演变的细粒度解释，并有效降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: DynSurvX is a model-agnostic, Shapley-based explainability framework that delivers time-resolved, fine-grained explanations for dynamic survival predictions with mixed static and longitudinal covariates, using a hierarchical two-phase strategy that reduces computational cost.
